  • Joint/skin functional ingredients: MSM (Methylsulfonylmethane)

  • Needed for the absorption of iron

  • May help with reducing body fat by inhibiting the conversion of carbohydrate into fat

  • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
  • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

5) 붕해 : 적합(60분이내)

[정제2 : 엠에스엠, 비타민D]

2) 플라보놀배당체 : 표시량의 80 ~ 120% (표시량 : 36 mg / 2,500 mg)
3) 깅콜릭산(ginkgolic acid)(mg/kg) : 5.0 이하

5) 비타민C : 표시량의 80 ~ 150% (표시량 : 30 mg / 2,500 mg)
6) 납(mg/kg) : 1.0 이하
7) 카드뮴(mg/kg) : 1.0 이하
8) 수은(mg/kg) : 1.0 이하
9) 비소(mg/kg) : 1.0 이하
